title: Analytical batch
purpose: Manage one analytical batch’s membership, current results, QC and supporting equipment and preparation information.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: These are staff pages. Active users with an application staff role can read them; client accounts cannot. Analysts perform result entry and batch work, reviewers decide results, and administrators maintain configuration. Administrators also have operational analyst and reviewer access, but independence rules still apply. Superuser status alone does not grant an application role.

items.label: Batch
items.description: The number, Open/Closed state, exact method/version and matrix identify the batch. The progress fact counts tests whose current result is entered (not yet submitted), returned by review, and approved, out of all tests in the batch. Approved count requires the latest approved revision to belong to this batch.

items.label: Returned notice
items.description: Shown while results in this batch are returned by review. It names up to ten returned results with links to each result and, for analysts, links to Enter results; every returned result must be entered again with a reason before it can be resubmitted.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Linked primary asset or Not recorded. Set or Change opens the Equipment form below.

items.label: Preparation start
items.description: Recorded combined-batch start or Not recorded. Set or Change opens Preparation time.

items.label: Created
items.description: Creator and creation time.

items.label: Closed
items.description: Closing actor and time appear after closure.

items.label: Notes
items.description: Optional notes saved when the batch was created.

items.label: Close batch
items.description: Analysts can close a nonempty open batch. The confirmation dialog explains that closure cannot be undone: sample and QC membership can no longer be added or removed. Entry, QC measurement and review continue. Closing does not approve results.

items.label: Import results
items.description: A menu with the two import paths: Standard CSV file opens the standard CSV validation and preview flow; With a saved mapping opens profile-mapped CSV/TSV import.

items.label: Enter results
items.description: Open entry for awaiting, entered or returned results; the number counts all currently enterable tests, regardless of current filters.

items.label: Add tests
items.description: Analysts can add eligible requested tests while membership is open.

items.label: Preparation start
items.description: Required when saving Preparation time; laboratory local time. Cannot be more than two minutes ahead, precede collection (composite end), or violate recorded preparation/QC chronology.

items.label: Save preparation time
items.description: Analysts save the start with an audit event. Submitted or approved dependent revisions freeze the time. Return submitted results first; approved corrections require a new batch with the correct time. Existing entered revisions are preserved but must be entered again to use the new time before submission.

items.label: Instrument or equipment
items.description: Choose a nonretired asset, keep the existing linked asset even if now retired, or choose Not recorded to clear it.

items.label: Save equipment
items.description: Analysts update the informational primary asset and audit the change. Equipment does not control approval or release.

items.label: Search
items.description: Partial, case-insensitive lab sample ID, client sample ID or analyte across the whole batch.

items.label: Status
items.description: Any status, Needs entry (awaiting, entered, returned), Awaiting entry, Entered, Awaiting review, Returned or Approved.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Expand Holding time and QC.

items.label: Holding time
items.description: Filter latest revision evaluation: Met, Exceeded, Not evaluable, No holding rule or Nothing entered.

items.label: QC
items.description: Held by QC or No QC hold uses current analytical batch findings affecting the test definition. Clear does not assert preservation or other approval requirements are satisfied.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Lab ID linking to result revisions and corrections.

items.label: Status
items.description: Current result state. An approved revision from another batch is identified as reanalysis and linked to its approval batch.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Requested analyte.

items.label: Prepared aliquot
items.description: Linked independent preparation batch and aliquot label, or Not linked. A timestamp alone does not establish an aliquot identity.

items.label: Result
items.description: Latest numeric observation as supplied, or ND with the applied reporting-limit threshold; soil weight basis is also shown. A non-detect is not represented as zero.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Frozen revision unit, or current test unit before entry. No conversion occurs.

items.label: Reporting limit
items.description: Limit applied to this specific revision, not just the current method default.

items.label: Qualifiers
items.description: Frozen qualifier codes; hover text explains their recorded meaning.

items.label: Holding
items.description: Holding evaluation frozen at entry: met, exceeded, not evaluable or no rule.

items.label: QC
items.description: Held for unresolved current batch QC findings affecting the test; Clear means no such analytical QC hold.

items.label: Dilution
items.description: Revision dilution factor; hidden initially.

items.label: Analysis start
items.description: Revision’s start date/time; hidden initially.

items.label: Entered by
items.description: Person who entered the latest revision; hidden initially.

items.label: Remove
items.description: Analysts can remove a test only from an open batch before any revision has ever been entered. It becomes unassigned; its requested test is retained.

items.label: Select all entered results on this page
items.description: Check current latest entered revisions on this page only. Batch totals may include entered results on other pages.

items.label: Submit selected for review
items.description: Analysts submit each selected current draft revision separately. You become its submitter and cannot review it, even if another analyst entered it. Stale or foreign selections are skipped with a warning; other eligible selections can succeed.

items.label: Submission holds
items.description: An exceeded holding time needs a recorded holding-time qualifier. Not-evaluable chronology or missing preparation blocks submission. A preparation timestamp changed after entry requires a new entry. QC and preservation findings are independently checked at approval; submission itself does not resolve them.

sections.title: Quality control
paragraphs: No QC requirements configured means no frequency requirements are enforced for this method. Any QC sample present still needs measurements for applicable definitions. Missing or unevaluated QC and failing QC hold approval until resolved or independently accepted for the current finding. No QC measurements or no samples is an explicit empty state.

items.label: QC holds approval
items.description: Current blocking findings are listed once, with latest disposition or an independence conflict where applicable. Record disposition, shown to analysts and reviewers, opens the decision for that specific finding.

items.label: Preparation time needed
items.description: Names active holding rules requiring preparation when none is recorded. Entering now cannot yield a submittable evaluation; set preparation and re-enter.

items.label: Required for this method
items.description: QC type, Required, In batch and Status compare configured frequencies with current QC sample counts. Required is the larger of minimum per batch and the rounded-up sample-count frequency. Counts retain historical membership after reanalysis moves samples.

items.label: Add QC sample
items.description: Analysts can add a labeled QC sample while the batch is open.

items.label: QC sample heading
items.description: Shows its label, type and a linked parent field sample for matrix spikes and duplicates.

items.label: Record measurements
items.description: Analysts enter or correct measurements, including after membership closure.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Analyte represented by the current QC observation.

items.label: Observed
items.description: Unchanged observed text such as ND or a decimal.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Stored measurement unit.

items.label: Spike
items.description: Spike amount or true value when relevant.

items.label: Evaluation
items.description: Pass, Fail or Not evaluated against currently active limits for the phase and test.

items.label: Detail
items.description: Calculated recovery/RPD or value finding and its limit explanation.

items.label: Entered by
items.description: Actor who recorded the current QC measurement.

sections.title: Filtering and table controls

items.label: Apply
items.description: Apply search and filters to the entire matching dataset and return to page 1. Invalid filters show errors and no rows; they never widen the query.

items.label: Clear all
items.description: Remove search and filters and restore this page’s defaults. A filter chip removes only that filter.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: Choose 25 (default), 50 or 100. First, Previous, Next and Last page links retain filters. Counts describe all matching records.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show or hide optional columns and change their order using movement controls or header dragging. Changes apply immediately and are saved for this table in your account, on any workstation. Locked columns stay available.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restore the original column visibility and order. Done or Close dismisses the Columns dialog.

paragraphs: Samples/results use fixed lab ID, analyte and record order. Filters and pagination affect that table only; QC, warnings and counts describe the whole batch.

sections.title: Laboratory records
paragraphs: This section shows today’s records for information. It does not establish conditions when work occurred or grant/block entry, approval or release. Empty stock-use, nonconformance or capability lists say no matching record is shown, not that a staff member is unqualified.

items.label: Standards and reagents used
items.description: Material name, linked Lot, signed quantity Used with unit, When (effective time to the second, in laboratory local time with its zone abbreviation), By and Notes show stock-use movements recorded against this batch. Use later reversed and Used after expiry flags preserve context.

items.label: Open nonconformances
items.description: Linked open records show number, title, status, severity and owner. Open a number for details. A count notes any closed linked records.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Asset links show current Status, Calibration due and Maintenance due. Due state is based on today; a date before today is overdue, a date within 30 days is due soon. Last not acceptable flags the latest calibration outcome.

items.label: Current demonstrations of capability
items.description: Staff, linked Record, Effective and Expires show current matching method and matrix records. Admin, reviewer, approver and project-manager roles see all staff; other staff see their own records only. No expiry set means the record has no expiry date.

sections.title: History and changed work
paragraphs: All membership, preparation, equipment, entry, submission and QC changes are attributed in audit history. A result page preserves every revision. A bulk submit may partly succeed, but grid entry and file import use all-or-nothing validation. Reload when the server says membership or dependencies changed, and check current state before retrying. If this URL identifies a preparation batch, it redirects to that batch’s preparation page.
